---
title: "Using the Orchestra Platform"
---

## What is Orchestra Platform?

Orchestra spins up isolated, time-limited RStudio and JupyterLab sessions on Kubernetes, enabling users to click a link and start working in the browser, with nothing to install.

## How to use Orchestra Platform

In your web browser, navigate to <https://orchestraplatform.org/>.

Click on "Launch a workshop".

You will be prompted to log in via a Google account.

Once logged in, click "New Session" in the top right corner.

Find the workshop "Single-cell RNA-seq analysis with R/Bioconductor (Physalia 2026)", and click "Launch".

Leave settings to default and click "Launch Session".

**Your session may take a few minutes to launch.**
Consider launching it during the presentation so that it is ready to use when you need it during the breakout session.
